**Pathway:** {{< meta pathway >}}\
**Prerequisites:** CS02 and CS04\
**Previous:** [CS08 Benchmark challenge](cs08-benchmark-challenge.qmd)\
**Next:** [SQ02 Fault stations](sq02-fault-stations.qmd)

Record the known-good baseline and photograph every side before opening. Create a fastener map and cable map. Remove only the RAM, storage, cables, fans, or drive cages approved for this station.

Explain the electrical and mechanical purpose of each connector or fastener removed. Reassemble, complete the ready-to-power gate, POST, and acceptance check.

Never open the PSU. Stop for liquid, a swollen cell, burnt areas, damaged parts, or uncertainty.

Submit the photo sequence, maps, parts-tray record, and verified return to service.
